tools.name: recent_changes
tools.title: Claude's recent changes
tools.description: The changes you (Claude) have made on this desktop with Nightdrive's tools, newest first: id, time, what it was (notice), the tool and its arguments, and state (done, or undone). Use it when the user asks to undo something, to find which change they mean.

tools.name: undo_change
tools.title: Undo a change
tools.description: Undo a change you (Claude) made with Nightdrive's tools, when the user asks ("undo that", "put the old wallpaper back"): by its id from recent_changes, or without one the newest change still in place. It puts back what was there before the change; the user sees it in a notification, with Redo.

id.description: The change's id, as recent_changes or the change's own answer gave it
